Rambus customer credit downgrade OR bankruptcy OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 前五大客戶占合併營收約 66%（2024、2023 皆 62%），公司預期集中度將持續。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Our top five customers for each reporting period represented approximately 66% of our consolidated revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 62% of our consolidated revenue for both the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023. We expect to continue to experience significant revenue concentration for the foreseeable future.
Our revenue from companies headquartered outside of the United States accounted for 82% of total revenue in 2025 as compared to 64% in 2024 and 62% in 2023.

findings.claim: 搜尋未發現 2026 年 Rambus 主要客戶信用降評、破產或客戶端下修財測的報導；僅見分析師對 Rambus 本身降評（Baird，2026-04-28）。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果摘要（Seeking Alpha: Rambus falls after rating cut at Baird）

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶信用面查無來源；搜尋摘要稱 Q3 2026 前三季 top5 為 63%、Customer A 23%、Customer B 18%，未讀到原文，列為 clue。
